deviations: Stata rdrobust vce(cluster code_city) is implemented as R rdrobust 4.1.1 cluster=code_city with vce='cr1' (plug-in residuals, CR1 weights), the R equivalent; masspoints off, triangular kernel, p=1, q=2, MSE-optimal common bandwidth.
reghdfe residualization and event studies use fixest::feols with fixef.rm='singleton' (reghdfe drops singletons).
geonear nearest-neighbour matching (ellipsoid) is implemented with a Vincenty WGS84 distance in R; matches kept within 400 km, with replacement.

Only the parts of Prepare_Data.do needed for the claims are rebuilt (station_day, station_month+AOD, did_ddl_match, city-day and city-month search data); the rd underreporting dummy and the neural-net PM10 correction are not needed for the claimed columns and were skipped.
notes: Seeded mode; followed Prepare_Data.do and Tables.do. attempt-1 and attempt-2 were exploratory (column order of the .dta files, rdrobust 4.1.1 vce/cluster handling and runtime on noise outcome; no RESULT lines). The first estimating run reproduced all 13 claims to the printed precision (also matching the paper's SEs, bandwidths and effective Ns, e.g. col1 h=109, N=91,470; col2 h=263, N=232,326; matched-sample N=186,499 / 186,469), so it is the final run and no claim-feedback attempts were used. Runtime ~14 s.
